title: Fully assembled, lightweight and sturdy.
text:
Fully assembled, lightweight and sturdy.. This is a nice little table. It looks great with any decoration. It's lightweight, yet sturdy.

I love the wood look, not sure of the material for the top, but it's nice and hasn't stained.

This Stone & Beam Arie Octagonal End Table came fully assembled.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Aire Rustic Octagonal Fir Wood Coffee Table, 39.5"W, Black & Natural
features: This handsome coffee table will be a stylish focal point along with providing a place for remotes and trays of snacks. A rustic wood top is married with a sturdy iron frame, making this piece great for farmhouse and industrial decor.
Fir wood top with iron base
This versatile table will fit with modern, industrial or farmhouse design
Assembly in 15 minutes or less; just attach top to base
